messages:
Maya: quick thread to finalize DP invite routing + launch gates for the April beta. main goals: low-friction onboarding, clear telemetry choices, and measurable quality gates.
Carlos: I can own routing. proposal: priority order = tier (enterprise, growth, seed) -> workload (chat, embed) -> region. keeps enterprise first.
Zoe: agree. include a hard capacity check before provisioning and an auto-fallback to hosted with a notification to the customer.
Finn: outreach cadence: initial invite, 4-day reminder, final 10-day nudge. include a one-click accept that posts to our webhook.
Maya: telemetry options: none, basic (aggregated metrics), debug (sampled prompts + traces). must surface retention and encryption in the consent modal.
Carlos: routing matrix sketch: enterprise->reserve VPC slots; growth->dedicated if available else hosted; seed->hosted only. numbers: reserve 6 enterprise slots, 15 growth rolling, 4 standby.
Zoe: acceptance checklist for onboarding: security review, KMS configured, contact for incidents, deletion endpoint present. Legal: confirm we can promise deletion within 30 days.
Legal: yes we can commit to 30-day deletion SLA in the DP addendum; will draft short addendum.
Finn: launch criteria proposal: 1) three partners running stable for 48h, 2) P50 latency within target, P95 within soft limit, 3) feedback eval shows <5% regression vs baseline, 4) no open critical security issues.
Maya: add retention metric: 65% active sessions after 7 days, otherwise trigger health check.
Carlos: automation: webhook payload on accept -> creates GH issue in dp-onboarding and triggers provisioning pipeline. I'll PR the payload spec: {user_id, account_id, tier, telemetry_choice, accept_ts}.
Zoe: add rollback policy: canary for 30m, if errors spike >2% or latency doubles then rollback to hosted; notify customer and ops.
ops-bot: Created alert rule `dp-provisioning-capacity` threshold 75%. Notifying #eng-oncall.
Maya: outreach copy draft: "Join our April beta — low-effort, opt-in, choose how much telemetry to share. Reply or click accept to reserve a slot." Finn to A/B test subject lines.
Finn: I'll share cadence spreadsheet + subject lines in 2 hours.
Maya: action items: Carlos -> routing matrix + webhook PR; Finn -> cadence + A/B; Zoe -> provisioning + rollback doc; Legal -> DP addendum; Maya -> outreach send and kickoff meeting Fri 3pm.
Carlos: will post routing CSV and PR today.
Zoe: provisioning doc by Thurs. includes deletion endpoint URL and SLA text.
Legal: addendum draft by Thurs EOD.
Maya: thanks all. keeping this thread as single source for these decisions. ping @here if blockers come up. :rocket:
